items.title: Govt unveils offer for sale to dilute LIC stake
items.description: The Centre has announced an Offer for Sale in Life Insurance Corporation of India.  This issue will open for non-retail investors on Tuesday and retail investors on Wednesday.  The divestment includes a base offer of 2.5% with an additional 4% greenshoe option.  The floor price for the Offer for Sale is fixed at ₹382 per share.  This move aids the insurer in meeting minimum public shareholding norms ahead of schedule.

items.title: These large-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of more than 20%
items.description: It was after quite some time that market breadth, always a better indicator of underlying sentiment, was positive for a few trading sessions in a row. This is what needs to be watched, rather than the movement of the Nifty or Sensex. In fact, for the next few sessions, it is critical to look at market breadth because the indices will give confusing signals, especially at the start and end of each session.

items.title: Promoter ownership climbs to two-year high despite persistent FII selling
items.description: Indian promoters significantly boosted their stock purchases in the June quarter. This action drove their ownership in listed companies to a two-year peak. Meanwhile, foreign institutional investors reduced their holdings to a fourteen-year low. Domestic investors absorbed much of the foreign sell-off, reaching an all-time high. This trend highlights growing domestic participation in Indian equity markets.

items.title: Stocks in news: Paytm, LIC, Airtel, BSE, and ONGC
items.description: Markets extended gains on Monday, driven by easing oil prices and strong quarterly earnings.  Paytm's parent company sees investors selling shares worth up to Rs 2,002 crore.  The government will offer shares in LIC to non-retail investors starting Tuesday.  Airtel, ONGC, and BSE will announce their first quarter results today.  ONGC's petroleum facility will reserve half its capacity for strategic reserves.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The Indian market began the week with strong momentum and expects continued positive sentiment. Encouraging first-quarter earnings and easing crude oil prices are supporting this upward trend. Investors will closely watch the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy meeting for further market direction. Developments in the US-Iran conflict and ongoing earnings season also remain key focus areas. Foreign portfolio investors and domestic institutional investors showed net buying activity on Friday.

items.title: New closing auction triggers confusion, sparks late Nifty swings
items.description: Market participants faced confusion during the new auction system's debut.  Indices and stock values diverged significantly, catching traders by surprise.  The new system determines closing prices through a separate auction process.  This change aims to create more robust closing prices for derivatives.  Tuesday's derivatives expiry will be a key test for the new system.

items.title: Stock Radar: Hero MotoCorp stock breaks out from a Flag pattern; time to buy?
items.description: Hero MotoCorp has broken out of a bullish Flag pattern on weekly charts, supported by strong volumes, positive technical indicators and sector strength. Analysts expect the stock to climb towards Rs 5,820 in the coming months, with a stop-loss at Rs 5,170.

items.title: Credit to tech infrastructure sector doubles in two years
items.description: Bank loans for India's technology infrastructure sector have doubled in two years. This growth reflects India's position as a global hub for data centers. Loans to IT services and digital infrastructure rose significantly year on year. This expansion is driven by data centers, GCCs, and IT enabled services. These segments are now showing robust growth in bank credit.

items.title: Sensex rises over 100 points, but Nifty50 slips near 24,600. Here’s why
items.description: The Indian stock market witnessed a mixed session on Tuesday as the Sensex rose over 100 points while the Nifty 50 dropped over 150 points to trade near 24,600. The divergence follows volatility from the newly introduced Closing Auction Session framework on the NSE amid widespread losses in sectoral indices.

items.title: FIIs build a new Banking XI without the usual heavyweights. Will the big banks return?
items.description: Foreign investors reduced stakes in large banks during the June quarter. They simultaneously increased holdings in several mid-sized and smaller private lenders. This shift reflects a preference for banks with specific growth triggers and fundamentals. Large banks still offer strong franchises and reasonable valuations for investors. The rotation depends on future earnings and valuation evolution.

items.title: Nalco among 5 stocks that closed above VWAP, signaling bullish shift
items.description: On August 3, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied over 2% relative to their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), and a shift above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which it was traded throughout the day, with the average being weighted by trading volume. This occurrence is often interpreted as a potential bullish signal by traders and investors. This potentially indicates positive sentiment in the market.

items.title: SBI Funds Management shares in focus after first earnings since IPO; net profit jumps 3% to Rs 873 crore
items.description: SBI Funds Management reported a 3.3% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 873 crore for Q1 FY27, its first quarterly result post-listing. Revenue from operations grew 15.2%, while mutual fund QAAUM reached Rs 12.6 trillion to retain market leadership.

items.title: LIC shares tumble 8% as OFS opens at 11% discount. All you need to know
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India shares fell as the government plans a stake sale. The offer for sale opens for non-retail investors on July 4. Retail investors can participate in the stake sale on July 5. This divestment aims to increase LIC's public shareholding gradually. The government seeks to raise funds through this significant stake sale.

items.title: Paytm jumps over 4% after Rs 2,038-crore block deal; Saif Partners, Elevation Capital likely sellers
items.description: Paytm shares rose over 4% following a significant block deal. Early investors Saif Partners and Elevation Capital trimmed their holdings in the fintech firm. This secondary share sale involved approximately 2.3% of Paytm's outstanding equity. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings with increased net profit. Paytm's board also approved an additional investment into its subsidiary Paytm Money.

items.title: LTM among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, indicating possible uptrend
items.description: On August 03, five Nifty500 stocks that gained over 6% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.

items.title: 9 microcap multibaggers: How India's stock market minnows beat every major index in six months
items.description: India's smallest listed stocks delivered the strongest market run in six months. The Nifty Microcap 250 index rose eleven percent, beating other size indices. Sterlite Technologies led gains with a four hundred twenty-four percent return. Fund managers expect earnings growth in smaller companies to improve soon. However, microcap stocks carry risks of sharp corrections and liquidity issues.

items.title: Block deal alert: Meesho shares in focus as Peak XV, Elevation Capital eye Rs 1,900 crore stake sale
items.description: Peak XV and Elevation Capital plan to sell a 2.3 per cent stake in Meesho via Rs 1,900 crore block deals. This follows Meesho narrowing its Q1 net loss to Rs 133 crore, while brokerages like Citi and Morgan Stanley remain divided on near-term growth dynamics.

items.title: Want Rs 10 crore for retirement in 20 years? How much you should SIP every month
items.description: Building a Rs 10 crore retirement fund in twenty years demands early and consistent monthly investments.  An investor can start with Rs 53,700 monthly and increase contributions by ten percent annually.  Factoring in inflation requires a higher starting SIP of Rs 85,000 with annual increases.  Equity mutual funds, particularly flexi-cap and mid-cap, are recommended for aggressive investors.  Consistent investing over two decades is the most crucial factor for reaching financial goals.

items.title: Urban Company among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On August 3, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 6% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels.“RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Vedanta Aluminium, Hyundai Motor among 25 stocks for dividend payout worth Rs 430
items.description: As per Sebi's T+1 settlement cycle, investors must buy a company's shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action. Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy the shares so that they are credited to their accounts by Friday, making them eligible for the dividends.

items.title: Reliance Industries, ICICI Bank among 11 stocks with over 3% FY27 earnings upgrades. Own any?
items.description: Nifty companies have delivered a stronger-than-expected start to the first quarter earnings season, with profits of the 39 index constituents that have reported results so far rising 11% year on year, according to domestic brokerage Motilal Oswal. Here are the top 11 stocks where earnings upgrades have increased by more than 3% from Motilal Oswal.

items.title: Vedanta to demerge real estate business after 5-way split. What can shareholders expect?
items.description: Vedanta announced plans to demerge its real estate business into a new company. Shareholders will receive one share of Vedanta Property Platforms for every twenty shares held. This new entity will later debut on the stock exchanges, listing on BSE and NSE. The demerged real estate portfolio includes significant land and property assets across India. This move follows Vedanta's recent five-way business split, aiming to unlock shareholder value.

items.title: Stocks to buy in 2026 for long term: Sun Pharma, Bajaj Finserv among 5 stocks that could give 10-30% return
items.description: Brokerages remained constructive on select stocks across sectors, with several seeing meaningful upside despite recent market volatility.We have collated a list of recommendations from top brokerage firms from ETNow and other sources:

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 9 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: On August 3, 20 stocks in the Nifty500 pack saw their closing prices cross above their 200-day moving averages (DMA). Among them, we have highlighted the top nine stocks that gained more than 3%, based on StockEdge.com's technical scan data. The 200-day daily moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Godfrey Phillips shares jump 7% as Samir Modi seeks peace with mother Bina Modi
items.description: Godfrey Phillips India shares jumped as much as 7% after Samir Modi said he would withdraw all legal cases against his mother, Chairperson Bina Modi, signalling a possible end to the family's long-running succession dispute. Investors welcomed the move as it eased corporate governance concerns surrounding the cigarette maker.

items.title: Ather Energy share price target goes up to Rs 1,714. What are CLSA, Nomura, and HSBC saying?
items.description: Ather Energy shares surged up to 18% after the electric two-wheeler maker reported a sharp improvement in its June-quarter performance, prompting global brokerages including Nomura, CLSA, HSBC and Emkay to reiterate bullish views. Analysts cited strong demand, improving margins and capacity expansion, with target prices implying upside of up to 35%.

items.title: Top 10 stocks with 7-14% dividend yields. Do you own any?
items.description: While the domestic stock market navigates persistent volatility driven by global economic cues and geopolitical developments, income-focused investors continue to look for high-dividend payout stocks. A stock's dividend yield measures the annual dividend payout relative to its current share price, offering investors a reliable indicator of cash returns.According to SBI Securities, several companies across diverse sectors continue to reward shareholders with substantial payouts. Here is a look at 10 high-dividend yield stocks.

items.title: Dabur shares drop 3% after FSSAI bars FMCG major from selling products with '100%' guarantee claims
items.description: Dabur India shares fell nearly 3% after the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) barred the FMCG company from selling certain food products carrying misleading "100%" claims. The regulator said labels such as "100% Natural" and "100% Pure" violate the Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018, as they are ambiguous, unverifiable and likely to mislead consumers.

items.title: Thangamayil share selloff continues: Stock drops 5% despite Rs 344 crore sales in first 3 days of August
items.description: Thangamayil Jewellery shares fell significantly despite robust August sales figures. The company reported strong sales during the auspicious Aadi Perukku festival. However, weak guidance and market uncertainties impacted investor sentiment negatively. Customers postponed purchases due to gold price expectations and geopolitical concerns. The company anticipates demand recovery in the latter half of the fiscal year.

items.title: KEI Industries shares surge 7% after Q1FY27 profit jumps 40%, revenue rises 23%
items.description: Shares of KEI Industries rallied nearly 7% to Rs 5,363.20 on Tuesday following a 40% year-on-year jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 274 crore. Revenue from operations rose 23% to Rs 3,185 crore, backed by strong domestic wires and cables demand.

items.title: GE Shipping shares rally 9% as Q1 net profit surges 160% YoY, revenue up 67%
items.description: GE Shipping shares rallied sharply on Tuesday after the company reported a 160% year-on-year jump in Q1FY27 net profit and a 67% rise in revenue. The shipping major also announced an interim dividend of Rs 14.40 per share, while improving fundamentals and positive technical indicators supported investor sentiment.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Goldman Sachs maintains buy rating on Jindal Stainless; Citi recommends sell call on Biocon
items.description: IGI: Morgan Stanley stays bullish, citing strong certification-market growth and the company’s shift toward a consumer-focused business.Jindal Stainless: Goldman Sachs remains positive, backed by resilient earnings, improving profitability and continued debt reduction.

items.title: Ather Energy shares zoom 18% after Q1 results. Why is it Nomura's top 2-wheeler pick?
items.description: Ather Energy shares rose sharply on Tuesday after the electric two-wheeler maker sharply narrowed its June-quarter loss and reported strong revenue growth with positive EBITDA. Nomura retained its Buy rating, raised the target price to Rs 1,714, and kept Ather as its top electric two-wheeler pick, citing improving margins, scale and long-term growth prospects.

items.title: DLF shares dip 2% as Q1 revenue tumbles 53%, but Nomura and others maintain Buy. Here's why
items.description: DLF shares saw a decline after reporting muted first-quarter results for FY27. The company's net profit grew minimally while revenue from operations experienced a significant year-on-year drop. New sales bookings were impacted by deferred launches, which are expected to commence from the second quarter. Brokerages largely retained their 'Buy' ratings, anticipating future growth from upcoming project introductions.

items.title: Restaurant Brands Asia shares surge nearly 20% on strong Q1 results. What Motilal, other brokerages said
items.description: Restaurant Brands Asia shares surged nearly 20% after the Burger King India operator posted strong Q1FY27 results, led by robust same-store sales growth and a sharp jump in EBITDA. Brokerages, including Motilal Oswal and Nuvama, remained bullish, citing improving demand, margin expansion and growth supported by Inspira Global's investment.

items.title: Aimtron Electronics shares can rally to Rs 2,036? Here’s why Nuvama initiated coverage on the platform stock
items.description: Nuvama Wealth Management has initiated coverage on Aimtron Electronics with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 2,036, implying nearly 47% upside. The brokerage expects strong growth driven by the company's shift to high-margin ESDM solutions, expanding order book, capacity additions and global expansion through its US acquisition.

items.title: For those with an investment horizon of over 1 year: 5 mid-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential up to 30%
items.description: For a while now, the world's risk appetite has been pouring into one story above all others: The AI trade, and into markets most tied to it. A great deal of money has gone to places like Taiwan and Korea, the homes of the chipmakers at the centre of that boom. India, with little to offer in that particular trade, was passed over. If the AI trade cools, even a little, some of that money has to go somewhere. And when global investors trim their bets on one crowded story, they look around for the next place to park their money.

items.title: ICICI Securities initiates coverage on 7 PSU banks with positive valuations
items.description: ICICI Securities commenced its analysis on seven public sector banks, giving most a Buy rating. They predict a strong return on equity for these institutions leading up to fiscal year twenty twenty-eight. Loan growth should remain vigorous, estimated at fourteen to fifteen percent each year. While asset quality is likely to stay stable, they caution about possible disruptions related to oil and climate change.

items.title: LIC OFS: Non-retail portion booked 55% on Day 1. Here’s what investors should know
items.description: LIC's Rs 31,410-crore offer for sale (OFS) saw the non-retail portion subscribed 55.1% by noon on Day 1. The government aims to pare its stake through a 2.5% base offer, with an additional 4% green shoe option, while retail investors can bid on August 5.

items.title: Why stock market's CAS Day 1 hiccups will fade within a few sessions
items.description: India's new Closing Auction Session (CAS) witnessed expected Day 1 adjustments, including concentrated liquidity and temporary futures-cash divergence. The article argues these teething issues are typical of global market transitions and should ease within a few sessions as participation deepens, improving price discovery for benchmark closing prices.

items.title: Epack Prefab Technologies shares rally 10% after Q1 revenue jumps 24%
items.description: Epack Prefab Technologies shares surged over 10% after the company reported a 24% year-on-year rise in June-quarter revenue, supported by strong project execution and regional expansion. While margins softened due to higher input costs, the company expects them to recover in the coming quarters as capacity additions and a healthy order book support growth.

items.title: Nifty's value doesn't change suddenly at 3:30 pm, NSE clarifies amid CAS confusion
items.description: Nifty’s last-minute 200-point surge after the launch of the Closing Auction Session (CAS) sparked confusion among traders, prompting NSE to clarify the index calculation process. Introduced on August 3, CAS alters the method for determining closing prices for F&O stocks through an auction mechanism. The new system aims to improve price discovery and reduce last-minute price impact.

items.title: Sensex falls 210 points, Nifty closes below 24,650 as market snaps 4-day gaining streak
items.description: Indian benchmark indices ended lower on Tuesday, snapping a four-day winning streak as the Sensex dropped 210 points to 78,429 and the Nifty fell 159 points to 24,615. Volatility stemmed from weekly expiry and discrepancies under the newly introduced Closing Auction Session (CAS) framework, which triggered forced square-offs ahead of the RBI policy outcome.

items.title: How dumb I was! When Peter Lynch regretted not buying Warren Buffett's favourite stock whose product his daughter used
items.description: Legendary investor Peter Lynch expressed regret over missing out on Apple despite his daughter buying an iPod, calling the oversight a mistake given Apple's simple business model and strong balance sheet. Lynch emphasized his core investing rule to know what you own before putting money into any stock.

items.title: 13 smallcap stocks see MF buying for 4 straight quarters; shares rally up to 103%
items.description: Over the last four quarters, mutual funds (MFs) have consistently increased their holdings in nearly 97 smallcap companies, with June 2025 taken as the base period. Retail investors often closely monitor the investment moves of large institutional players such as MFs, whose stock selections are typically backed by in-depth research. Of these companies, 23 smallcap stocks that witnessed steady increases in MF ownership delivered returns of over 25% in the past year. Among them, 13 stocks rallied between 50% and 103%, with one multibagger more than doubling investors' wealth over the 12-month period. (Data Source: ACE Equity).

items.title: Sebi aims to relax offshore fund investor-disclosure rules as appeals grow: Report
items.description: India's market regulator is set to simplify disclosure requirements for offshore funds to entice more long-term foreign investment. The proposed adjustments include extending the disclosure timelines for fresh investors and increasing the thresholds for reporting specific investor information. These initiatives emerged in response to legal challenges and complaints from investors, seeking to create a more conducive environment for capital influx.

items.title: Market wrap: RIL, Hindalco, Trent among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks ended lower, snapping a four-session winning streak amid expiry-day volatility and the new closing auction system. Sensex fell 210 points and Nifty lost 159 points, while investors tracked RBI policy, crude oil trends and global bond yields.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Top investment voices. One stage. Market-defining ideas
items.description: Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 brings together leading experts in asset management, private credit, wealth management and market strategy to examine the forces shaping capital allocation, global investing, GIFT City, alternative assets and the future of wealth creation.

items.title: TVS Motor Company among 7 stocks hitting 52-week highs; surge up to 20% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex declined by 210 points to settle at 78,428 on Monday. However, despite the broader market weakness, eight stocks from the BSE 100 Index surged to new 52-week highs, reaching their strongest levels in the past year. A 52-week high is a positive technical indicator, signalling strong investor demand, improving market confidence, and continued upward momentum in a stock’s price.

items.title: India's new closing auction stokes sharp Nifty swings, options volatility on weekly expiry
items.description: India's Nifty 50 index faced notable volatility yet again, largely driven by the recent implementation of a new closing price mechanism. This development coincided with the expiration of weekly derivative contracts, which created turmoil among traders. As the Nifty 50 moved lower, experts indicated the necessity for critical adjustments to the new pricing system to address the prevailing issues.

items.title: Filatex India shares can rally to Rs 118? Why Equirus Prive initiated coverage on the stock
items.description: Equirus Prive has initiated a Buy on Filatex India with a Rs 118 target, implying 53% upside. Capacity expansion, cost-saving initiatives, high-margin recycling business Ecosis and favourable industry tailwinds are expected to drive strong earnings growth and margin expansion through FY29.

items.title: Institutional investors over-subscribe LIC OFS, govt opts for green-shoe option
items.description: The government's Life Insurance Corporation share sale has garnered overwhelming attention from institutional investors, with bids amounting to an impressive Rs 36,400 crore received on Tuesday. The government is offloading a 6.5 percent stake in the leading insurer to fulfill regulatory public shareholding mandates sooner than anticipated. Retail investors will have the opportunity to engage in this offer beginning Wednesday.

items.title: India's hospitality companies' revenue to grow 7-9% in FY27, West Asia conflict poses downside risks: ICRA
items.description: India's hospitality sector anticipates seven to nine percent revenue growth this fiscal year.  Premium hotel occupancy is expected to remain stable at seventy-two to seventy-four percent. Average room rates for premium hotels will likely increase to eight thousand six hundred rupees.  Operating margins for these hotels are projected to be similar to last year's figures.  However, geopolitical tensions pose potential downside risks to this outlook.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Paytm among 2 stock recommendations for Wednesday
items.description: Markets ended lower after Monday’s rally as profit booking, heavyweight weakness and caution over the new closing auction mechanism weighed on sentiment. Analysts recommended buying Deepak Fertilisers and Paytm, citing strong technical setups, bullish momentum and favourable risk-reward for the near term.

items.title: Worst of FPI equity selling may be over for India: Report
items.description: The wave of selling from foreign portfolio investors in Indian equities may have reached its end. The resilience of domestic economic fundamentals, accompanied by improving investor sentiment, is promising. With inflows turning positive in June and July, supported by heavy debt investments, foreign investment seems poised for continued strength as India maintains its robust growth.

items.title: Sebi proposes depository receipts against REITs, InvITs units
items.description: India's markets regulator has unveiled a fresh set of regulations concerning depository receipts aimed at real estate and infrastructure investment trusts. This initiative seeks to draw increased foreign investment into these vital sectors, providing overseas investors with a new channel to trade these units. Interested parties must submit their feedback on the proposals by August twenty-fifth.

items.title: Traders on edge! Why Nifty jumped 150 points in final minutes again
items.description: Nifty rebounded nearly 150 points during Tuesday’s closing auction after spending most of the session in the red, highlighting the impact of the new Closing Auction Session. Analysts attributed the volatility to expiry-day adjustments and early implementation issues in the revised closing price mechanism.
